title: Marconi: Prefix Caching for the Era of Hybrid LLMs
technique: Prefix cache for Hybrid (Attention+SSM) LLMs: radix tree, speculative-insertion admission that admits only SSM states with high reuse likelihood, and FLOP-aware eviction (utility = recency + FLOP savings per byte)

optimized_metrics.evidence: Its primary goal is maximizing the cache utilization to reduce redundant computation and minimize TTFT latency.

headline_claim.text: Marconi achieves up to 34.4x higher token hit rates (71.1% or 617 ms lower TTFT) compared to state-of-the-art prefix caching systems.

reported_metrics.where: Fig 7 (boxplots with P5/P95 whiskers), Fig 8, Fig 10a
Fig 9 (P95 TTFT relative to no prefix caching), Fig 10b (P5, P50, P95)

metric_definitions.definition_quote: We define token hit rate as the ratio of the number of tokens that skipped prefill over the total number of input tokens.
metric_definitions.notes: Token-weighted per request (distribution over requests shown with P5/P95 whiskers), not request-level hit/miss.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: flop efficiency = Total FLOPs across layers / Memory consumption of all states
metric_definitions.notes: New metric: compute saved by reusing a prefix cache entry per byte of cache memory; drives eviction.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: We also evaluate different percentiles (P5, P50, and P95) of time to first token (TTFT, ms). FLOP saved is a reasonable proxy for compute and latency savings because prefill is easily compute-bottlenecked.
metric_definitions.notes: TTFT is evaluated at P5/P50/P95; whether queueing is included is not stated (trace replay on vLLM-based implementation).

metric_definitions.definition_quote: Prefix caching mitigates this by caching and reusing the model's internal states that represent the common prefixes (Fig. 2), achieving a lower time to first token (TTFT) latency, lower tail time per token (TPT) latency, and higher prefill throughput (measured in tokens/s).
metric_definitions.notes: Motivation only; TPT and prefill throughput never measured.

load_regime: trace replay (LMSys, ShareGPT, SWE-Bench) with varying request arrival patterns, cache sizes, and hybrid model architectures
tradeoff_acknowledged: Judicious admission reduces coverage; FLOP-aware eviction trades hit rate of shorter sequences for longer ones: P5 TTFT is 6.3% worse than SGLang+ (2.1 ms absolute) while P50/P95 TTFT improve by 13.4%/22.0%.
hardware: AWS instance with eight A100-40GB GPUs, 96 Xeon vCPUs (vLLM implementation on four A100-40GB)
models: 7B Hybrid models (Mamba-Attention, ratio 1:6 etc.), Jamba-like configs
